title: Irish Chicken Tagine
description: A twist on the classic Moroccan dish, this Irish Chicken Tagine combines the rich flavors of the Irish countryside with the bold spices of North Africa.
instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from pot and set aside. Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add lemon juice, broth, and spice blend to pot. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to pot and bring to a boil.
Cover pot and transfer to oven. Braise at 300°F for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
